items.headline: Organised Crime Bill cleared by Supreme Court
items.summary: Speaker Jagath Wickramaratne announced the court's ruling that the Bill is consistent with the Constitution. It can pass with a simple majority if the amendments proposed by the Attorney General and the court are added at Committee Stage.

items.headline: Budget 2027 Committee Stage debate begins
items.summary: Parliament started the Committee Stage debate today. Minister Ananda Wijepala said the President's expenditure head includes Rs. 34 million for former presidents and Rs. 6.5 billion for Clean Sri Lanka.

items.headline: Two directors held over alleged Rs. 4bn investment fraud
items.summary: CID financial crimes officers arrested two directors of Kandy- and Kohuwala-based firms accused of taking about Rs. 4 billion from some 2,000 investors with dividend promises that were never kept. They are due before the Nugegoda court.

items.headline: Landslide warnings for Kandy, Kegalle and Nuwara Eliya
items.summary: The NBRO issued amber warnings for Yatinuwara and Mawanella and a yellow warning for Ambagamuwa, valid until 5 AM tomorrow. More afternoon thundershowers are forecast across most of the island in the coming days.

items.headline: Justice Minister explains Chemmani excavation report
items.summary: Harshana Nanayakkara told Parliament that Prof. Raj Somadeva's report is an archaeological assessment, and the cause of death will be decided separately in court. About 574 individuals have been recovered so far, and the government is open to foreign forensic help with DNA work.

items.headline: Thai Deputy PM on four-day visit
items.summary: Thailand's Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow arrived for talks with Sri Lankan leaders and a Buddhist ceremony in Kandy. A visa-free travel deal for ordinary passport holders is expected to be signed.

items.headline: FBI team meets police and AG's Department
items.summary: Visiting FBI officials discussed cyber fraud, international criminal networks and digital-evidence training with the AG's Department and police units, including the computer crimes unit.

items.headline: Human-elephant conflict plan due by 20 December
items.summary: A first draft of the national action plan must go to the parliamentary oversight committee by 20 December, followed by a meeting with stakeholders to finish it.

items.headline: West Asia crisis slows road building
items.summary: Bitumen imports, usually sourced from Iran, have been disrupted, and only limited supplies are coming from India, China, Thailand and Malaysia. The RDA says imported materials make up about 15–20% of the cost of the three expressways proposed in the Budget.

items.headline: Sri Lanka and Tatarstan to deepen trade ties
items.summary: After talks in Kazan, Tatarstan agreed to take part in Sri Lanka Expo 2027 (14–17 January). Talks also covered vehicles, ICT, energy, fertiliser and education.

items.headline: Harmful chemicals in 13 of 16 Boondi samples
items.summary: The Consumer Affairs Authority is taking legal action against the traders. Separately, 21 imported ice cream, milk tea and syrup samples that exceeded microbial limits have been sent for further testing.

items.headline: Fire at Thalawathugoda scrap metal yard
items.summary: Fire trucks from Colombo, Kotte and Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia were sent to contain a blaze at a scrap metal depot in Polwatta, Thalawathugoda (Pannipitiya).

items.headline: More assets of ex-Matara co-op chief frozen
items.summary: Police suspended the use of two more properties belonging to Chaminda Gunasekara, worth about Rs. 127 million in total, as part of an illegal-assets probe.

items.headline: Appeal Court cuts priest's rape sentence to 13 years
items.summary: The court upheld the conviction of a temple priest for raping a displaced 17-year-old student in Mullaitivu in 2011, but reduced his jail term from 17 to 13 years.

items.headline: Unhealthy air in seven areas
items.summary: NBRO readings show unhealthy air for sensitive groups in Mannar, Galle Fort, Dambulla, Hambantota, Badulla, Kurunegala and Nuwara Eliya. Newsfirst reports that the NBRO expects air quality to improve today.

items.headline: Western Province win National Games table tennis
items.summary: Western Province topped the table tennis event at the 50th National Sports Games in Bandaragama with three golds, ahead of Southern Province.

items.headline: Trump threatens tax on US firms building AI data centres abroad
items.summary: He warned of a heavy tax on US tech companies that build AI data centres overseas, saying they would otherwise help China, but did not say how it would be enforced.

items.headline: FBI crime database breached
items.summary: US media report that the FBI has been hacked again, this time in a breach that targeted its criminal records database.

items.headline: Bolsonaro taken to hospital
items.summary: Brazil's former president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to hospital with abdominal pain.
